notes: replicas: no replicas or scale key in the adservice block (docker-compose.yml:48-77); its deploy block sets only resources.limits.memory (docker-compose.yml:56-59). Library default, not in these files.

healthcheck: no healthcheck key in docker-compose.yml:48-77. The process exposes a gRPC health service (AdService.java:99, healthMgr.getHealthService(); status SERVING at AdService.java:113). No heartbeat or cleanup schedule.
registry, discovery, coordinator: none. No registry or discovery client in the dependency list (build.gradle:43-58).
messaging: none. No Kafka or other messaging client in build.gradle:43-58 and no messaging depends_on in docker-compose.yml:48-77.

syncEdges: only the flagd evaluation call sites are outbound (AdService.java:172, 205, 209). FlagdOptions at AdService.java:87-90 sets no host, port or transport. FLAGD_HOST and FLAGD_PORT are passed through by docker-compose.yml:65-66 and set at .env:129-130. The flagd provider reads them and uses gRPC by library default; neither is stated in these files.

telemetry destination: docker-compose.yml:67 sets OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=http://${OTEL_COLLECTOR_HOST}:${OTEL_COLLECTOR_PORT_HTTP}. .env:27 and .env:29 resolve this to otelcol:4318. docker-compose.yml:70 sets OTEL_LOGS_EXPORTER=otlp. The OTLP protocol, signal paths and export intervals are library defaults (OpenTelemetry Java agent), not in these files.

telemetry on or off: OTEL_SDK_DISABLED, OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER, OTEL_METRICS_EXPORTER, OTEL_LOGS_EXPORTER and JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS are set from OTEL_CANDIDATE_ADSERVICE_* variables whose values are not in these files (compose.candidate-postures.yml:27-31, harness repo). The Dockerfile sets JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS=-javaagent at Dockerfile:28.

exportsTelemetryTo.note: Resolves the OTEL_COLLECTOR_HOST reference in docker-compose.yml:67 (OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=http://${OTEL_COLLECTOR_HOST}:${OTEL_COLLECTOR_PORT_HTTP}); port 4318 at .env:29. Logs go to the same endpoint via docker-compose.yml:70. Active only if the candidate posture variables enable export (see extraction.notes).

syncEdges.note: Synchronous OpenFeature flag evaluation through the flagd provider on the request path. Protocol and host are not in this line (see extraction.notes).
